facts.claim: In 1881, Bombay had 107 insurance companies, including 38 for fire, 22 for life, and 47 for marine insurance.
facts.quote: In 1881 Bombay contained 107 insurance companies, of which 38 dealt with fire, 22 with life, and 47 with marine insurance.
